trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Checked deployment history** for checkout-api: v2.3.1 (unhealthy in production) was the latest deploy; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error left us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1), so I retried, and the rollback completed successfully.
3. **Verified health**: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down from ~18% to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0002, on-call paged) titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0", documenting the failed deploy, the partial-then-completed rollback, and current healthy status.
